runtime_target_transport: none: offline, scripted models, no audio and no transport
provider_model_settings: pydantic-ai FunctionModel; ALLOW_MODEL_REQUESTS=False, so a real provider request raises rather than being made
command_or_scenario_recipe: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 GOOGLE_API_KEY=offline-test-placeholder .venv/bin/python -B -c 'import sys, runpy; import pydantic_ai.models as models; models.ALLOW_MODEL_REQUESTS = False; runpy.run_module(sys.argv[1], run_name="__main__")' tests.test_flow
expected: Destination-prefix split, truncation and invalid name cause no premature action
actual: A hand_over whose destination is split mid-stream executes once, on the complete validated arguments, with the whole name. A separate throwaway enum proves the prefix-of-a-valid-name case: nothing runs until the arguments parse whole.
limitations: Offline and scripted. No real provider accepted these schemas, no audio was synthesised or recognised, and no carrier was involved. Nothing here transfers to a live call.

The split points are chosen by the test, not by a provider. A real provider may chunk differently; this shows the mechanism cannot act on a partial argument, not that every real chunking has been tried.
